why.title: Why it exists
why.statement: Too often, people of short stature are treated online as a curiosity rather than as people. {brand} starts from the other side: a place where everyone meets as an equal, and nobody is anyone's novelty.
why.body: Mainstream apps weren't designed with this community in mind, and support forums aren't where people go to date or make friends. {brand} brings dating, friendship, community and opportunity together in one place, with safety built in from the start.

about.title: About {brand}
about.lead: {brand} is a social network for dating, friendship, community, events and opportunities. It's built around people of short stature and open to people of all heights who connect with respect.

mission.title: Our mission
body: A world where everyone belongs, and meaningful connections have no boundaries.
That means a place where people of short stature can date, make friends, find community and grow their careers without having to explain themselves first.

centre.title: Built around people of short stature
body: Adults of short stature are the community at the centre of {brand}. Product decisions start with their safety, dignity, privacy and ownership.
Everyone else is welcome on the same terms: as an equal, here to connect with people rather than to look at them.

items.title: Everyone meets as an equal.
items.body: Nobody is a curiosity or an attraction. Language that treats people that way isn't allowed.

items.title: You decide what you share.
items.body: How you identify is self-described, optional and private unless you choose to show it.

items.title: Safety comes with every feature.
items.body: Blocking, reporting and moderation open at the same time as the features they protect.

items.title: No ranking by looks.
items.body: We don't rank people by appearance, height or popularity, and we don't guess things about you from your photos.

items.title: Honest about what's ready.
items.body: We say what exists today and what's still coming. No invented members, numbers or stories.

markets.title: Where we're starting

safety.title: Safety at {brand}
safety.lead: Safety tools open with every feature, never after it. Here's how {brand} protects you, and what you can do.

adults.title: Adults only
adults.body: Everyone on {brand} is 18 or older. We check date of birth when you sign up, and may ask for an age check where the law requires it or when an account is reported.

verification.title: Verification is optional
verification.body: You can verify your identity to earn a badge. It's never a condition of joining, and it isn't a test of who belongs. A specialist provider runs the check. We keep the outcome, never your documents or images of them.

identity.title: How you identify is your choice
identity.body: Saying you're a person of short stature, a family member or an ally is optional. It's private by default and shown on your profile only if you choose. We never ask for a diagnosis or medical records.

location.title: Your location stays approximate
location.body: {brand} knows only the country and optional city you enter. Your device's location is never used, your city is hidden until you show it, and nobody sees your address.

tools.title: Block and report
tools.body: Block anyone, and they can no longer see or contact you. Report profiles, messages, posts and events. Reports go to our moderation team, a person makes the final decision, and you can appeal a decision about your own account.

rules.title: What we act on
rules.body: These are the kinds of behaviour our moderators act on. The Community Guidelines explain each one.

messages.title: About messages
messages.body: Messages are protected in transit between your device and our servers. They're not end-to-end encrypted, and we won't say they are unless that changes.

meeting.title: Meeting someone in person
items: Meet somewhere public for the first few times.
Tell a friend where you're going and who you're meeting.
Arrange your own way there and back.
Keep talking on {brand} until you trust someone.
Never send money or share financial details.
Leave whenever you feel uncomfortable.
Report anyone who pressures you.

danger.title: If you're in danger
danger.body: If you're in immediate danger, contact your local emergency services first. Then report the account so we can act on it.

questions.a: Anyone aged 18 or older who agrees to treat others with respect. {brand} is built around people of short stature and open to people of all heights.
We're opening country by country, so safety, payments and legal requirements are ready in each place first. This site lists the countries that are open.
Yes. Free membership is what's available at launch. Paid plans with extra features will come later, and safety tools are part of every membership.

questions.q: Do I have to say I'm a person of short stature?
questions.a: No. Saying how you identify is optional. If you do, it's private unless you choose to show it, and you can remove it at any time. We never ask for a diagnosis or medical records.

questions.q: Do I have to verify my identity?
questions.a: No. Verification is optional and earns a badge. It's never a condition of joining.

questions.q: Can anyone see where I live?
questions.a: No. {brand} only knows the country and optional city you enter. Your city is hidden until you show it, and we never use your device's location.
Your photos are kept in private storage and shown according to your privacy settings. They aren't available at public web addresses.

questions.q: Can I download or delete my data?
questions.a: Yes. You can ask for a copy of your data, and you can delete your account. Deletion starts with your account being deactivated straight away, then everything is permanently removed after a short grace period.
Use the report option on their profile, a message or a post. Reports go to our moderation team, and a person makes the final decision.

questions.q: What happens when I block someone?
questions.a: They can no longer see your profile or contact you. They aren't told that you blocked them.

questions.q: Someone made me uncomfortable because of my height. What can I do?
questions.a: Report them. Objectifying or fetishising anyone is against our Community Guidelines, and accounts that do it can be removed.
Use the reset option on the sign-in page to choose a new password. If that doesn't work, see Contact.

meta.description: Draft Privacy Policy: what {brand} collects, why, how sensitive information is protected, and your rights.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.lead: What {brand} collects, why, how we protect it, and the choices and rights you have.

about.title: About this policy
paragraphs: This policy explains how {brand} handles personal data. It's written with Kenya's Data Protection Act, 2019 and the EU and UK General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) in mind. It doesn't claim compliance with any of them: that will be confirmed through legal and technical review before launch.
We collect only what we need to run the service and keep members safe.

operator.title: Who is responsible for your data
paragraphs: The company that operates {brand} is the data controller for the personal data described here.

collect.title: What we collect
paragraphs: Depending on what you use, we hold:
items: Account details: your email address, a securely hashed password (never the password itself), your date of birth, and records of your sign-ins and active sessions.
Profile details you choose to add: display name, country, an optional city, languages, a short biography, interests, hobbies, what you're looking for and up to nine photos.
Your settings: privacy choices and discovery preferences, such as the age range you want to see.
How you identify, only if you choose to tell us (see below).
The outcome of any verification check you choose to take (see below).
Safety records: reports you make or that are made about you, blocks, moderation decisions and appeals.
An audit log of sensitive actions on your account, such as staff access or changes to your verification status.
Limited technical data, such as IP address and browser type, kept in security logs to protect accounts and prevent abuse.
after: Messages, posts, events and payments are not part of {brand} yet. This policy will be updated to cover them before they open.

identity.title: How you identify: sensitive information
paragraphs: You can tell us that you're a person of short stature, a member of any height who wants to be part of the community, a family member or an ally, or choose "prefer not to say". This is entirely voluntary.
Because it may reveal information about health or disability, we treat it as sensitive personal data, as Kenya's Data Protection Act and Article 9 of the GDPR do. So:
items: We ask for your explicit consent before storing it, and record when you gave it.
It's stored separately from the rest of your profile.
It's hidden by default. It appears on your profile only if you turn that on.
You can withdraw consent at any time, and it's deleted.
We never ask for a diagnosis or medical records, and never infer it from your photos or behaviour.
Staff can see it only when their role requires it, and that access is logged.

verification.title: Verification
paragraphs: Verification is optional and never a condition of joining. If you choose to verify your identity, age or that you're a real person (a liveness check), a specialist verification provider runs the check.

We store only the outcome: the type of check, its result, when it happened and the provider's reference. We never store your identity documents, images of them, ID numbers or the selfies used for the check. The provider handles those under its own terms, which we'll link here once a provider is chosen.

location.title: Location
paragraphs: We never collect your exact location. Our website turns off access to your device's location, and we store no coordinates.
We know only the country you choose and, if you add it, your city. Your city is hidden by default, and nearby discovery is off until you turn it on.

photos.title: Photos
paragraphs: Photos are kept in private storage and served through short-lived links, never at public web addresses that could be guessed. We remove location data embedded in photo files before storing them, and photos are reviewed against our Community Guidelines.

use.title: How we use your data
items: To run your account and show your profile according to your settings.
To suggest people, communities and events, based on what you've told us. We never rank people by appearance or infer sensitive characteristics from images.
To keep members safe: reviewing reports, enforcing our rules and preventing fraud, spam and abuse.
To protect accounts and the service, for example by detecting suspicious sign-ins.
To send you messages about your account, such as security alerts.
To meet our legal obligations.
after: We don't sell members' personal data.

bases.title: Our legal reasons for using data
items: Contract: to provide the service you signed up for.
Consent: for how you identify and other optional information. You can withdraw it at any time.
Legitimate interests: to keep members and the service safe and secure, balanced against your rights.
Legal obligation: where the law requires us to keep or share information.

sharing.title: Who we share it with
items: Other members, only what your profile and privacy settings allow.
Service providers that help us run {brand}, such as hosting, email and verification, under contracts that limit what they can do with it.
Authorities, when the law requires it or someone's safety is at serious risk.
after: Organisations on {brand} never get access to member profiles, private messages or member lists.

transfers.title: International transfers
paragraphs: Some of our providers store data outside Kenya and outside your country. When data leaves the country it was collected in, we put in place the safeguards the law requires, and this section will name the regions involved before launch.

retention.title: How long we keep it
paragraphs: We keep your data while your account is open. When you delete your account, it's deactivated straight away and permanently deleted after a short grace period, including your profile, photos, how you identify, settings and verification outcomes.

Some records are kept longer where safety or the law requires it, such as the audit log of sensitive actions and records of serious rule-breaking. These never contain message content, documents or passwords.

rights.title: Your rights
paragraphs: You can:
items: Access the personal data we hold about you.
Correct anything that's wrong.
Delete your account and your data.
Export your data in a portable format.
Object to, or ask us to restrict, how we use it.
Withdraw consent you've given, at any time.
Complain to a data protection authority, such as Kenya's Office of the Data Protection Commissioner or the authority where you live.
after: Deleting your account and downloading your data will be available from your account settings.

age.title: Adults only
paragraphs: {brand} is only for people aged 18 or older. If we learn that an account belongs to someone younger, we close it and delete its data.

security.title: How we protect it
paragraphs: Data is encrypted in transit and at rest. Staff access is limited to what each role needs, and every sensitive staff action is recorded in a log that can't be edited. No system is perfectly secure, so we'll tell you without undue delay if a breach puts you at risk.

changes.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: We'll update this policy as {brand} adds features, and tell members about significant changes before they take effect.

account.title: Your account

conduct.title: Treating others with respect
paragraphs: {brand} is built around people of short stature, and everyone here meets as an equal. You agree to follow the Community Guidelines. In particular, you won't:
items: Harass, threaten, stalk or intimidate anyone.
Objectify or fetishise anyone, including because of their height or body.
Post hateful or discriminatory content.
Share intimate images of anyone without their consent.
Pretend to be someone else, or misrepresent your age.
Scam, solicit money from or defraud other members.
Send spam or use automated tools to access the service.
Try to get around blocks, restrictions or security measures.

content.title: Your content
paragraphs: You own what you post. You give us permission to store and show it on {brand}, to the people your settings allow, only for as long as needed to run the service. When you delete content or your account, that permission ends, except where we must keep a copy for safety or legal reasons.
Only post content you have the right to share.

safety.title: Meeting people
paragraphs: We work to keep {brand} safe, but we can't vet everyone or guarantee how people behave. We don't run criminal background checks. A verification badge shows that a check passed, not that someone is trustworthy. Take care when meeting people, and see our safety tips.

moderation.title: Moderation and enforcement
paragraphs: If you break these terms or the Community Guidelines, we may remove content, warn you, restrict features, suspend or close your account. A person reviews decisions about accounts. You can appeal a decision, and we'll explain the outcome.

payments.title: Membership and payments
paragraphs: Free membership is what's available at launch. Paid plans aren't on sale yet. When they open, their prices, renewal and cancellation terms will be shown before you pay, and payments will be covered by additional terms.

ending.title: Ending this agreement
paragraphs: You can delete your account at any time. We may suspend or close accounts that break these terms or put others at risk, or if the law requires it.

liability.title: Our responsibility to you
paragraphs: We provide {brand} with reasonable care and skill. Nothing in these terms limits rights you have under consumer law that can't be limited. Further terms on liability will be added after legal review.

law.title: Governing law
paragraphs: The law and courts that govern this agreement are to be confirmed during legal review, and will appear here before launch.

changes.title: Changes to these terms
paragraphs: We'll tell you about significant changes before they take effect. If you keep using {brand} after that, the new terms apply.

meta.title: Community Guidelines
meta.description: Draft Community Guidelines: how members treat each other on {brand}, and what our moderators act on.

guidelines.title: Community Guidelines
guidelines.lead: {brand} works when everyone meets as an equal. These guidelines describe how we treat each other, and what our moderators act on.

respect.title: Talk to people, not about their height
paragraphs: {brand} is built around people of short stature and open to people of all heights. Nobody here is a curiosity, an attraction or a novelty.
items: Use the words people use for themselves, and ask if you're not sure.
Don't describe anyone as an attraction, a novelty or a type to collect.
Don't divide people into "normal" and "other". Everyone here is a member, whatever their height.
Don't make someone's height or body the subject of a message they didn't ask for.
Don't ask about medical history or diagnoses. People share what they choose.

harassment.title: Harassment
paragraphs: No unwanted contact after someone has said no, insults, pile-ons, mocking or shaming. Repeated messages to someone who doesn't reply count too.

hate.title: Hate and discrimination
paragraphs: No content that attacks or demeans people for their height, disability, race, ethnicity, nationality, religion, sex, gender identity, sexual orientation or age.

objectification.title: Objectification and fetishisation
paragraphs: No treating anyone as a fetish, a fantasy or an object because of their height or body. That includes sexualised comments about someone's stature, collecting or seeking out people as a "type", and requests based on someone's body rather than who they are. This applies to profiles, messages, posts and events.

exploitation.title: Sexual exploitation
paragraphs: No soliciting or offering sex for money, no sexual content involving anyone under 18, and no pressuring anyone into sexual conversations or content. We report child sexual exploitation to the authorities.

impersonation.title: Impersonation
paragraphs: Be yourself. No pretending to be another person or an organisation, no fake profiles, and no misrepresenting your age.

scams.title: Scams
paragraphs: No asking members for money, gifts, investments or financial details, and no romance scams or phishing links.

stalking.title: Stalking
paragraphs: No tracking, monitoring or trying to find out where someone lives, works or goes, and no contacting them elsewhere after they've blocked you or said no.

threats.title: Threats
paragraphs: No threatening violence or harm to anyone, including threats to expose private information.

images.title: Non-consensual image sharing
paragraphs: No sharing intimate or private images of anyone without their consent, and no photos or videos of other people taken or shared to mock them.

spam.title: Spam
paragraphs: No repetitive or bulk messages, advertising in conversations, or automated accounts.

reporting.title: Reporting
paragraphs: If you see something that breaks these guidelines, report it from the profile, message, post or event. Reports are confidential: the person isn't told who reported them.

enforcement.title: What happens next
paragraphs: Our moderation team reviews reports. Tools may help sort them, but a person makes the decision. Depending on how serious it is, we may remove content, warn, restrict features, suspend or permanently remove an account. You can appeal a decision about your account, and we'll explain the outcome.

displayName.label: Display name
displayName.hint: This is how other members see you. You can change it later.

newPassword.label: New password
newPassword.hint: At least {min} characters. A few unrelated words are easy to remember and hard to guess.

dateOfBirth.hint: You need to be 18 or older to join. For example, 27 3 1995. We never show your date of birth to anyone.

country.label: Country you live in
country.hint: Registration is opening country by country.

errors.summary: Some details need changing. Check the fields marked below.
errors.generic: Something went wrong on our side and nothing was saved. Try again in a moment.
errors.rateLimited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.

displayName.required: Enter the name other members will see.

email.invalid: Enter an email address in the format name@example.com.
email.too_long: Use an email address of 254 characters or fewer.

currentPassword.wrong: That password is incorrect. Check it and try again.

confirmPassword.mismatch: The passwords don't match. Type the same password in both fields.

dateOfBirth.invalid: Enter a real date, for example 27 3 1995.
dateOfBirth.in_future: Your date of birth must be in the past.
dateOfBirth.too_early: Check the year: it should be 1900 or later.

countryCode.required: Choose the country you live in.
countryCode.invalid: Choose the country you live in.

register.title: Create your account
register.intro: Joining {brand} is free. You need to be 18 or older.
register.underAgeTitle: You need to be 18 or older to join {brand}.
register.underAgeBody: We haven't kept any of the details you entered.
register.waitlistBody: We've added {email} to the waitlist. We'll write once you can join from {country}, and we won't use your address for anything else. Your password wasn't saved.

verifyEmail.sentBody: We've sent a link to the address you entered. Open it to confirm your email, then sign in. The link works for 24 hours.
verifyEmail.resendBody: Check your spam folder. If it isn't there, ask for a new link.
verifyEmail.resent: If that address has an account waiting to be confirmed, we've sent a new link.
verifyEmail.confirmBody: Select the button to finish setting up your account.
verifyEmail.confirmedBody: Your account is ready. Sign in to continue.
verifyEmail.invalidTitle: This link has expired or has already been used
verifyEmail.invalidBody: Sign in with your email and password and we'll send you a new link if you still need one.

login.title: Sign in
login.failed: The email address or password is incorrect. Check them and try again.
login.unverified: Confirm your email address first. We've sent a new link to {email}.
login.googleHint: Works once you've created an account with the same email address.
login.googleFailed: Google sign-in didn't work. If you're new, create an account first, then you can use Google to sign in.
login.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed. Sign in with your new password.
login.signedOutEverywhere: You've been signed out on every device.
login.deletionRequested: Your account will be deleted in {days} days and you've been signed out everywhere. To keep it, sign in again before then.

forgotPassword.title: Reset your password
forgotPassword.intro: Enter the email address you use for {brand}. We'll send you a link to choose a new password.
forgotPassword.sentBody: If an account exists for {email}, we've sent a link to reset its password. The link works for 1 hour.

resetPassword.title: Choose a new password
resetPassword.intro: Changing your password signs you out on every device.
resetPassword.invalidTitle: This reset link has expired or has already been used
resetPassword.invalidBody: Reset links work for 1 hour and only once. Ask for a new one.

security.title: Security
security.sessionsIntro: If you see a device you don't recognise, sign it out and change your password.
security.revokeLabel: Sign out this device: {device}, last active {when}
security.revoked: That device has been signed out.
security.revokeFailed: That device was already signed out.
security.onlyThisDevice: You're only signed in on this device.
security.everywhereBody: Signs you out on every device, including this one. Use it if you've lost a device or think someone else can get into your account.
security.passwordIntro: Other devices are signed out when you change your password.
security.passwordChanged: Your password has been changed and your other devices have been signed out.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.intro: Deleting your account removes your profile, photos, settings and verification results. This is what happens:
deleteAccount.stepNow: Right away, you're signed out on every device and your profile is hidden.
deleteAccount.stepGrace: For {days} days you can change your mind: signing in again keeps your account.
deleteAccount.stepAfter: After {days} days, your account and everything in it are deleted for good. This can't be undone.
deleteAccount.exportFirst: Want a copy of your data first? <link>Download your data</link>.
deleteAccount.wrongPassword: That password is incorrect. Your account hasn't been changed.

exportData.title: Download your data
exportData.intro: Get a copy of the information {brand} holds about you, as a JSON file you can open in any text editor.
exportData.includes: It includes your account details, sign-in methods and devices, profile, photo details, self-identification, privacy settings, discovery preferences and verification results. It never includes your password or anyone else's information.
exportData.safety: The file contains personal information. Keep it somewhere safe and don't share it.

email.footer: You're receiving this because this address was used on {brand}.

verify.subject: Confirm your email address for {brand}
verify.body: Confirm your email address to finish creating your {brand} account.
verify.expiry: The link works for 24 hours. If you didn't create an account, you can ignore this email.

reset.subject: Reset your {brand} password
reset.body: Someone asked to reset the password for your {brand} account.
reset.expiry: The link works for 1 hour. If you didn't ask for this, ignore this email and your password stays the same.

existing.subject: Someone tried to create a {brand} account with your email
existing.body: Someone tried to register with this email address, but it already has a {brand} account.
existing.reset: Forgotten your password? Reset it here: {url}
existing.ignore: If it wasn't you, you don't need to do anything. Nobody can use your account without your password.
